speaker.name: Model Monica
speaker.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

output.objection: You are treating the manual experiment log as a cost we should remove, but it is the only thing keeping our model versions auditable. I need you to acknowledge that we are trading automation for strict governance, not just losing a tool.
output.correction: I am not saying the registry is broken or that we hate the work. I am saying that if we keep it manual, every entry must pass a formal review before it is accepted, which is a different requirement than the one you just noted.
